title: 第19章 白麓城陈家第20章 师姐的桃花师妹的羊毛
slug: 加入合欢宗后师妹的鱼塘炸了
content_zh:
第19章白麓城陈家“师父！”
徐一洲几人像是找到了主心骨，狼狈逃窜躲到段崖身后。
段崖目光微沉。
“逆徒，你就是这么纵容外人欺负同门的？”
云洛：？
“你没事儿吧？”
云洛无语到家了。
“老头，不要对别人的弟子占有欲那么强好吗？”
段崖六十岁才筑基，平日靠着劣质驻颜丹才维持着年轻人的模样。
云洛这句“老头”和踩他尾巴没区别。
偏偏这个时候褚璃突然补了句。
“天呐，天星宗元婴期就能当长老吗？”
她惊讶地捂嘴，好似见了什么颠覆三观的事。
段崖气得嘴唇颤抖。
“无知小辈！”
他在天星宗被捧惯了，加之得了机缘刚刚突破到元婴后期，见云洛身旁的褚璃不过金丹初期，不禁起了轻视之心。
“一日为师终身为父，你既不尊师重道，今日，老夫便连同你这个师姐一起教训了！”
说罢，灵力直取二人面门。
云洛的手指早就放在了手链的铃铛上。
她打不过，但保命的法器多的是。

但她还未出手，段崖的攻击便被一道无形的屏障挡了回去。
“离开客栈，否则，死！”
青蘅的声音被灵力放大，好似从四面八方传来，让人分不清她身处何处。
云洛知道，青蘅长老就在楼上的厢房里。
她化神初期的神识足够笼罩整个客栈，不用出门便知道发生了什么。
当然，也不用见面就能将人打飞。
这就是境界碾压。
云洛想恢复灵根的动力又涨了一大截。
段崖的攻击被尽数反弹，若不是他及时撑起灵力护体，后果不堪设想。
即使这样，他体内也气血翻涌，喉间溢出腥甜。
他眸光暗了暗。
刚才是他被气得理智全无，竟忘了合欢宗的长老皆是化神之上。
他狠狠擦掉嘴角的血迹。
“我们走！”
content_en:
Chapter 19 Bailu City Chen Family "Master!"
Xu Yizhou and the others seemed to have found their backbone, and fled in confusion behind Duan Ya.
Duan Ya's eyes darkened slightly.
"Traitor, is this how you allow outsiders to bully your fellow disciples?"
Yunluo:?
"Are you okay?"
Yunluo arrived home speechless.
"Old man, don't be so possessive about other people's disciples, okay?"
Duan Ya didn't build the foundation until he was sixty years old, and he relied on low-quality Zhuyan Dan to maintain his youthful appearance.
Yun Luo's words "old man" are no different from stepping on his tail.
But at this moment, Chu Li suddenly added.
"Oh my God, can I become an elder at the Nascent Soul stage of Tianxing Sect?"
She covered her mouth in surprise, as if she had seen something that subverted her views.
Duan Ya was so angry that his lips trembled.
"Ignorant junior!"
He was used to being praised in the Tianxing Sect, and he had just broken through to the late Nascent Soul stage due to the opportunity. Seeing that Chu Li beside Yun Luo was not in the early stage of the Golden Core, he couldn't help but feel contempt for him.
"Once a teacher, always a father. You don't respect the teacher. Today, I will teach you a lesson together with you, my senior sister!"
After saying that, the spiritual power came directly to the door of the two of them.
Yunluo's fingers had already been placed on the bell of the bracelet.
She couldn't defeat him, but there were many magic weapons to save her life.
But before she could take action, Duan Ya's attack was blocked by an invisible barrier.
"Leave the inn, or die!"
Qing Heng's voice was amplified by spiritual power and seemed to come from all directions, making it difficult to tell where she was.
Yunluo knew that Elder Qingheng was in the wing upstairs.
Her consciousness in the early stages of her transformation was enough to cover the entire inn, and she knew what was going on without leaving the house.
Of course, you don’t need to meet to blow someone away.
This is realm crushing.
Yunluo's motivation to restore his spiritual roots has increased a lot.
Duan Ya's attacks were all deflected. If he hadn't supported his spiritual protection in time, the consequences would have been disastrous.
Even so, Qi and blood surged in his body, and a fishy sweetness overflowed from his throat.
His eyes darkened.
Just now, he was so angry that he lost all reason, and he actually forgot that the elders of Hehuan Sect were all above the gods.
He wiped away the blood from the corner of his mouth.
"Let's go!"
